top_choice_rationale: P002 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) rewards the discovery chain: the human incretin effect and GLP-1 action, proglucagon-derived peptide biology, and characterization of the insulinotropic GLP-1(7-36) peptide, with independently confirmed benefit in diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The achievement is mature and original. I hold this with only moderate confidence because Mojsov's priority relative to the Habener group cannot be settled from the supplied record, so her inclusion rests on peptide characterization, not first discovery. P001 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) is a close second and a defensible fallback, since protraction chemistry removed the half-life obstacle; the gap between the two is one of emphasis. Any award is preferable to no award, as the science is mature and not disputed.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for the GLP-1 laureates; the only documented connections are co-authorship with Sandberg and others on unrelated work, and the 2016 spatial-transcriptomics paper, none involving the proposed laureates
